Planning something? We'd love to help.

We don't have an online booking system just yet — but that means you get a real conversation with a real person when you reach out. Whether you're gathering friends for a cacao ceremony, want in on our next moon meditation, or need a whole dessert for a birthday, wedding, or celebration, one call or visit is all it takes.

Ceremonies & Meditations

Cacao ceremonies and moon meditations happen regularly in our 1920s space beneath 14-foot wood ceilings. Spots are limited — call to reserve yours or ask what's coming up next.

Call to Reserve

Whole Dessert Orders

Celebrating something? Order a naturally sweetened whole dessert made with the same care as everything on our menu. Give us a call or stop in to place your order.

Order a Dessert

Prefer in person? Walk into 3349 Adams Ave any day of the week — our team can set you up on the spot.

A gathering place, first and foremost

Founded by Kathryn Rogers, Maya Moon Collective was built to be more than a cafe. Between the bi-monthly art installations, evening events, and community workshops, there's almost always something happening here in Normal Heights.

If you'd like to bring your own event to life in our space, or simply want to know what's on the calendar, give us a ring — we'll walk you through it.
